qa_pairs.question: Which fasteners on the transfer box require the highest torque specification?
qa_pairs.answer: The transmission cross member to rubber mounts (M12) requires 80 Nm, which is the highest torque specification shown.

qa_pairs.question: Do the M24x1.5 and M14x1.5 plugs have the same torque specification?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, both the M24x1.5 and M14x1.5 plugs require 33 Nm torque.

qa_pairs.question: What section of the service manual covers these transfer box torque specifications?
qa_pairs.answer: Section 27-2, Transfer Box - Four Wheel Drive
